subject: recruitment of Broken Blades
fact: Dren Halveth was currently taking bids to recruit his crew in three ways: outbidding the Water Temple, defeating him in a fist fight, or completing a task.
source_quote: Dren demanded to know who sent them, what they wanted in Nulb, and which gods they prayed to. The party explained they had gained territory in the temple for the Earth Temple. Dren revealed that a shipment of weapons belonging to his company had been stolen by the Crimson Reapers, who occupied the room next door. He tasked the party with retrieving the weapons without bringing the wrath of the temple down on everyone.
